releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.66 restores Smart Life identity on Home with a compact colorful 3D-style logo and keeps Home as the page label. The greeting, Celsius/Fahrenheit temperature and date are larger for readability, and Home now shows a live Bahrain time line that updates locally without extra network or location access. Quick Actions keep the same design and direct Scan, Search, New Note and Save Link behavior. Price Photos barcode-first behavior and all existing user data remain unchanged.
